note: Both sets extract the same Table 6-1 row values with correct bindings, units and elevation/HtFract conditions, and neither contains a misread or misbound value. remarks: Both extractions sample only ~24 of the 121 table cells and completely skip the paragraph's design parameters (6 m base diameter, 0.027 m base thickness, 3.87 m top diameter, 0.019 m top thickness, 210 GPa Young's modulus, 80.8 GPa shear modulus, 8,500 kg/m3 effective density vs 7,850 kg/m3 typical, 30% thickness scaling, 347,460 kg integrated mass, 38.234 m CG height) — these are the most important engineering facts on the page and both sets miss them. The two sets appear to come from the same extractor with minor sampling variation.
